# iosxe_wireless_mobility (Resource)

This resource can manage the Wireless Mobility configuration: the local mobility group name, the mobility MAC address, keepalive and DSCP settings, and the mobility group members (peers). The mobility configuration always exists on the controller, so destroying this resource only removes the configured attributes: the settings return to their defaults and the managed members are deleted. WARNING: changing `group_name` or `mac_address` on a live controller tears down its mobility tunnels. The controller refuses to change the `ip` or `public_ip` of an existing member; to re-address a member, remove it in one apply and add it again in the next.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_wireless_mobility" "example" {
  group_name               = "MOBILITY-1"
  mac_address              = "00:00:00:00:0c:01"
  group_keepalive_interval = 20
  group_keepalive_count    = 5
  dscp                     = 46
  group_members = [
    {
      mac_address          = "00:00:00:00:0a:20"
      ip                   = "192.0.2.20"
      public_ip            = "198.51.100.20"
      group                = "MOBILITY-2"
      ssc_hash             = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567"
      data_link_encryption = true
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `dscp` (Number) mobility dcsp value
  - Range: `0`-`63`
- `group_keepalive_count` (Number) Mobility Keep Alive count
  - Range: `3`-`20`
- `group_keepalive_interval` (Number) Mobility Keep Alive interval
  - Range: `1`-`30`
- `group_members` (Attributes List) List of Mobility Peers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_members))
- `group_name` (String) Local Mobility group name
- `mac_address` (String) Mobility local MAC address, in lowercase colon form (the controller stores it in lowercase).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--group_members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_members`

Required:

- `group` (String) Peer group name
- `ip` (String) Peer IP address. The controller refuses to change it on an existing member.
- `mac_address` (String) Mobility peer MAC address, in lowercase colon form (the controller stores it in lowercase).

Optional:

- `data_link_encryption` (Boolean) Peer data link encryption status
- `public_ip` (String) Peer public IP address. When omitted, the controller stores `0.0.0.0` (the `wireless mobility group member` CLI instead stores the member's `ip`). The controller refuses to change it on an existing member.
- `ssc_hash` (String) Peer SSC hash. The controller requires exactly 40 characters and stores the value in the case given.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_wireless_mobility.example ""
```
